invariants.rule: Exactly one global deadline owner exists and it is SUPERVISOR.
Every bounded stage records start timestamp, end timestamp, and budget.
DEADLINE_WARNING forbids starting a new high-cost search.
DEADLINE_EXPIRED forbids all new candidate, alternative, backup, and terminal search.
Expiry never converts nominal, desired, or uncertified control into an executable action.
A valid backup is complete and identity-compatible before expiry.
Expiry never makes a terminal action safe; CERTIFIED_TERMINAL_READY is required.
GLOBAL_DEADLINE_UNKNOWN and LOCAL_CERTIFICATE_TIMEOUT are distinct non-success results.
Certificate layers report local status and never set global time policy.
DEADLINE_EXPIRED is absorbing within the current control cycle.
All post-expiry in-method actions must already carry valid geometry and actuator authority.
Missing numeric deadline configuration produces GLOBAL_DEADLINE_UNKNOWN, never a default.
